question: Which of the following health campaigns was launched by President Draupadi Murmu through a virtual event on 13 September 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushman Bhav**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bhav** was launched by **President Draupadi Murmu** through a **virtual event on 13 September 2023**.
 
• This campaign aims to enhance the reach and impact of health services across India, particularly focusing on underserved and marginalized communities.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's ongoing efforts to provide comprehensive healthcare services to all citizens and bridge the gap in healthcare accessibility.
 
• Ayushman Bhav integrates various **health schemes** and programs under a unified framework to ensure better coordination and delivery of health services.
 
• The campaign also emphasizes the importance of preventive healthcare and wellness, encouraging citizens to adopt healthier lifestyles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **President Draupadi Murmu** has been actively involved in various initiatives aimed at improving public health and welfare since assuming office.
 
• The launch of Ayushman Bhav is a significant step towards achieving the goals set under the **National Health Policy 2017**, which aims to provide universal health coverage and ensure quality healthcare services to all.
 
• This initiative is expected to complement other flagship health programs like **Ayushman Bharat**, which provides health insurance coverage to economically vulnerable families.
 
• The campaign will also leverage digital health technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of health service delivery.
 
• Community participation and awareness are crucial components of the Ayushman Bhav campaign, encouraging citizens to actively engage in health promotion and disease prevention activities.
